note.zh-TW: 模板原字「應付賬款增加(+)」用了異體字，介面統一寫「帳」，原字列為別名；模板沒有減少列，減少時以負數填同一列（T12）。
note.en: The template spells payables with a variant character; the interface uses one spelling and keeps the original as an alias. There is no decrease line, so a decrease is entered as a negative on the same line (T12).

definition.zh-TW: 應付帳款增加表示有些進貨還沒付錢，省下的現金要加回稅前淨利。
definition.en: A rise in payables means some purchases have not been paid for yet, so the cash saved is added back to profit before tax.
